name: Helen Newman
description:
Helen Newman Hall is a full-service Cornell recreation center on North Campus. It includes a fitness room with cardio and strength equipment, a swimming pool, bowling lanes, and indoor courts for basketball, volleyball, and badminton.
Facilities: HNH Fitness Center, HNH Pool, HNH Bowling, HNH Court 1, HNH Court 2 | Activities: Bowling, Basketball, Volleyball, Badminton, Swimming | Amenities: Showers, Lockers, Parking, Elevators

name: ZUMBA®
description: Instructor: Livia. ZUMBA® combines Latin rhythms and international dance moves to create an upbeat, calorie blasting experience! With a fusion of Latin, Belly dance, Reggaeton, Hip-Hop, and other forms of dance, routines feature aerobic interval training with a combination of fast and slow rhythms that tone and sculpt the body. Spend 45 minutes dancing your worries away!

name: Pilates - Mat Express
description: Instructor: Sophia. Pilates is a conditioning program designed to increase body awareness, improve alignment and breathing. You will build endurance, flexibility, coordination, and strength through a highly focused flow of movements.

name: H.I.I.T. & Core
description: Instructor: Emily E.. H.I.I.T. & Core is a total-body interval training workout that incorporates cardio/plyometrics, strength, and core work, using a variety of equipment such as light dumbbells, bands, or just body weight and a mat. The class is typically structured around timed intervals, helping you push through each round with focus and intensity. Bring a sweat towel, water bottle, and let’s smash this high-intensity session!

name: Barre Express
description: Instructor: Olivia. This high-energy, low-impact class moves through a fast-paced series of exercises using small, controlled movements, isometric holds, and high repetitions—often with light equipment. You'll target muscles you didn’t even know you had, while strengthening your core, glutes, legs, and arms, and improving balance and posture.

name: Cycling Express
description: Instructor: Lynn. Short on time or just getting started with exercise? Cycling Express is the perfect way to fit in an efficient, effective cardio workout. This 45-minute indoor cycling class blends energizing music with basic cycling movements, motivational coaching and breath awareness.This low-impact, high-energy ride lets you set the pace to match your goals. Whether you're building stamina or simply boosting your mood, this class will move you.

name: Yoga - Hatha with Meditation & Breathwork
description: Instructor: Jessica. This yoga class combines physical postures with focused breathwork and meditation practices. The physical practice uses a combination of focused, grounded postures with gently flowing movements to prepare the body to sit with more ease. The breathwork includes several techniques to energize, sooth, or balance one’s energy. The class concludes with an accessible and guided meditation. Leave class feeling refreshed and empowered to use these breathwork and meditation techniques throughout your day!

name: Yoga - Slow & Mindful
description: Instructor: Jamie M.. This slow & mindful practice invites you to move, breathe, and feel your energy in a state of ease and presence. Rooted in the philosophy of Vinyasa, this style emphasizes slow, fluid, and mindful movements that unfold with the breath, creating a meditative and deeply grounding experience. Each session encourages you to connect with your body’s natural rhythm, exploring strength and flexibility through intuitive, unhurried sequencing. The slower pace allows space for deep awareness, subtle alignment, and inner stillness—making each movement a meditation in motion and offers a soothing journey into balance, and calm, steady energy.
